notes: ACCESS: direct curl_cffi fetch, HTTP 200 on the first attempt for every URL, no proxy and no blocking - the same route the prior Furniture pass recorded. The file also carries a Shopify agent notice that checkouts are for humans - nothing here touched cart, checkout or payment; only read-only catalogue endpoints were requested. probe.py's 2s per-host gap applied. There is NO Bath, Bathroom, Sanitaryware, Basin, Shower, Tap/Faucet, Toilet, Vanity or Bathroom Storage department at any level. (1) MEGA-MENU: fully enumerated above - all 69 child links listed and read; the closest non-linen candidates are Decor > Home Accents > Tissue Holders and Decor > Home Accents > Baskets, both inspected and routed out in review. Zero shower, toilet, basin, sink, tap, faucet, vanity-unit, bathroom-cabinet or sanitaryware collections exist. (3) FULL CATALOGUE: /products.json paged to exhaustion, 888 products, product_type histogram computed. The only bath-family types are Bath Rugs (2), Bath Towels (1) and Bathrobes (1) - the 4 products of /collections/bath, all textile. There is no soap dispenser, soap dish, toothbrush holder, tumbler, toilet-roll holder, towel rail/bar/ring, robe hook, shower caddy, bath tray, vanity unit, bathroom cabinet, basin, tap or mirror-cabinet product type anywhere in the catalogue. (4) SITE SEARCH: the storefront's own search was exercised and shown to work (q=rug -> '112 results'). q=bathroom returns 28 results, q=shower 20, q=vanity 6, q=towel 7 - and every hit was resolved to a real product: they are the same bath linen, the porcelain tissue holders, the linen wastebaskets, two consumable 'Soaps & Lotions' (Scented Hand Soap Carmen, Trudon Liquid Soap Vixi), plus three near-miss false positives that were opened individually and rejected - 'daisylane-bathroom' is the Dollhouse Bathroom Set (product_type 'Cait Kids Toys', a children's toy), 'vida-bamboo-guest-towel-holder-white-and-natural' is product_type 'Serveware', a Beatriz Ball melamine beverage-napkin holder for entertaining, and 'blossom-trellis-porcelain-tissue-holder' is product_type 'Boxes', a decorative porcelain trinket box ('storing small treasures'). Nothing survives as a Bathroom listing node. QTY: for every node inspected the qty came from the theme's OWN rendered listing header, the string 'See N results' on the collection page, and was then INDEPENDENTLY re-derived by exhausting /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 and counting unique product ids - exactly the two-method scheme the Furniture pass used on this site. Both agreed exactly on 4 of 4 nodes: bath 'See 4 results' = 4 unique ids; tissue-holders 'See 10 results' = 10; storage-baskets 'See 7 results' = 7; wall-floor-mirrors 'See 10 results' = 10. The numbers discriminate (4/7/10/10, and the same method returns 70 on shop-all-bedding), so they are real per-collection totals, not a site-wide constant, and each page's h1 was checked to confirm the right listing loaded ('Bath', 'Tissue Holders', 'Baskets', 'Mirrors'). No count was estimated, inferred from pagination, or aggregated. EXCLUDED and why: /collections/shop-all-bedding (Shop All, rule 25) and the rest of the Bedding children (duvet covers, sheets, crib sheets, quilts & shams - Textile); the entire Lighting department (table/floor lamps, lamp shades, sconces, picture lights, flush mounts, chandeliers, pendants) because the site has no bathroom, vanity or mirror-light node, so rule 19 had nothing to route; Furniture (Living/Bedroom/Dining), Rugs, Pillows & Fabric, Wallpaper, Art, Entertaining (serveware, dishware) and Kids - none has a bathroom child; the single-product mirror landing collections (bengal-mirror, vera-mirror, ...) as promotional/product pages per rules 25 and 27; 'linen-wastebasket' and 'margot-bow-wastebasket-tissue-holder' for the same reason (single-product landing collections, and their products are already covered by the Baskets review row); 'accents' and 'candles-scents' (checked - contain none of the target product types); the 2 'Soaps & Lotions' products (consumable hand soap and liquid soap, not a soap dispenser/dish/holder - rule 13 covers the vessel, not the toiletry - and in any case they are products, not a listing node). CONCLUSION: this is a confirmed absence, not a block. Every URL requested returned HTTP 200 and rendered its real grid; the brand is a textiles, rug, wallpaper, furniture and decor house with a small bed-and-bath LINEN line and no bathroom department, fixtures, hardware, storage or mirrors of any bathroom kind. Status NO BATHROOM FOUND with rows = [] per rule 36; no fabricated rows, no invented URLs.
